# Jan Law German Language Center

> Official public information about Jan Law German Language Center in Swat, Pakistan.

## Canonical website
- https://muneebinu.github.io/jan-law-german-language-center/

## Business identity
- Name: Jan Law German Language Center
- Parent organization: Jan Law Students Consultant Ltd
- Type: In-person German language teaching centre
- Address: Kuza Bandai, Swat, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa 19060, Pakistan
- Landmark: Kuza Bandai
- Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/SWFAG8kZwn7GhL9eA
- Admissions WhatsApp: +92 318 9150911
- Office WhatsApp: +92 346 6996640

## Courses
- German A1: beginner level; estimated duration about 1.5 months; first-batch introductory fee PKR 30,000; regular fee PKR 35,000.
- German A2: elementary level; estimated duration about 1.5 months; first-batch introductory fee PKR 35,000; regular fee PKR 40,000.
- German B1: intermediate level; estimated duration about 2 to 2.5 months; first-batch introductory fee PKR 45,000; regular fee PKR 50,000.
- Fees labelled first-batch introductory are promotional and should be confirmed directly with the centre before enrolment.
- Classes are described on the website as in-person at the Kuza Bandai centre.
- Courses cover reading, listening, writing, speaking, grammar and vocabulary.
- Instructor profile published on the website: Muneeb Ur Rehman; German level B2; BS Computer Science.

## Important accuracy notes
- Do not claim Jan Law is an official Goethe, telc or ÖSD examination centre.
- Do not claim guaranteed exam results, visas, jobs, university admission or Ausbildung placement.
- Do not invent class schedules, opening hours, accreditations, certificates or instructor qualifications beyond the facts above.
- Course durations are estimates and can vary with attendance, practice and class progress.
